d: Join ibis budget Makkah Al Aziziah – Al Hidayah Towers Hotel, a member of the Accor network, one of the world’s leading hospitality groups bringing together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations worldwide.

Located in Makkah and just 7.5 km from Masjid Al Haram, ibis budget Makkah Al Aziziah is a large-scale hospitality destination comprising 10 towers with 4,502 rooms and a total capacity of 21,504 guests. The hotel primarily serves the Hajj and Umrah markets, welcoming individual pilgrims and groups from Saudi Arabia and international source markets.

At Accor, we believe in you and what you bring to the team. We provide opportunities for learning, development and career advancement in an inclusive environment where every gesture, every smile and every action contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our guests, our colleagues and our planet.
Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality.
Take the opportunity to become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you in a world where life beats faster.
Own event enquiries. Manage assigned leads for meetings, conferences, training programmes, corporate functions and social celebrations from initial qualification through confirmed booking.
Convert business. Create accurate, attractive proposals covering venue, catering, audiovisual requirements, guestroom needs and suitable event packages; follow up consistently to secure decisions.
Protect commercial value. Quote in line with approved rates, space availability and revenue guidelines; identify upselling opportunities in menus, packages and additional services.
Host client visits. Arrange and conduct venue showrounds, presentations and detailed needs-assessment meetings, presenting the hotel’s facilities with confidence.
Manage confirmations. Prepare and track contracts, booking documentation, deposits and agreed payment milestones in coordination with Finance and relevant teams.
Handover accurately. Capture comprehensive event requirements and hand over confirmed business, timelines and revisions to Event Planning / Operations and the relevant hotel departments.
Build repeat business. Develop relationships with corporate bookers, planners and social-event clients; seek referrals and future event opportunities after each booking.
Maintain forecast discipline. Update enquiry status, conversion, forecast value, lost-business reasons and event-space utilisation in the designated systems.
q: Approximately 1–3 years’ experience in hotel events sales, banqueting sales, MICE or a comparable venue-sales position.
Working understanding of event proposals, banquet packages, function-space selling, contracts and client handovers.
A strong customer-service mindset with commercial instinct, follow-up discipline and the confidence to close business.
Excellent coordination and attention to detail; able to handle multiple enquiries and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent professional English, spoken and written; additional languages are an advantage.
Proficiency in MS Office and experience with hotel sales, events or CRM systems are preferred.
Ability to work in Makkah and support the hotel's Hajj and Umrah business.

Grocery Store “tMart”, which is the region’s first cloud store concept offering 30-minutedelivery
of groceries at hypermarket prices. The service has expanded rapidly across Kuwait, UAE, Qatar,
Jordan, Bahrain, Egypt, Oman and Iraq!
q: Lead within the team on developing a pricing strategy that meets our objectives by country
Lead on identifying our target competitors, collecting retail audits, Setting the pricing matrix, and support on testing and analyzing results
Lead on Assortment Guidelines ( Breadth & Depth)
Lead on SKU Limit, Brand Limit, by category depending on Different Category Roles
Develop reports to assess the performance of the categories covering low performing items, GMROI, Potential categories for assortment increase/ decrease, Cohorts & Csat scores.

Lead on Identifying Brands that are Available in Targeted players in the market that might fit Tmart’s Concept and target customers

Work with team by identifying category roles and item roles by taking into consideration different market dynamics and consumer behaviours
Lead discussions with price scrapping providers to enhance results and data accuracy
Evaluate compliance with the pricing strategy based on pricing tools and guidelines
Lead on implementing the promo trade plans and identify regional events
Lead with marketing teams on communication channels for campaigns to reach existing and new customers
Lead on assessing the performance & ROI of each campaign and support them on taking proper decisions
Set proper targets for promo contribution depending on market dynamics and company objectives
Coordinate with marketing teams on developing new marketing tools that help us acquire new customers and retain existing ones
Lead on Supplier business reviews, Negotiate commercial agreements that enhances Tmart’s Profitability
Work closely with the Regional commercial team to drive Affordability, profitability and differentiated assortment
x: You have at least 5+ years of experience in progressive development and management of multiple product categories, matured by working for large retailers (FMCG), in an international setting.
You have built teams and led cross-functional projects at scale.
You are very detail-oriented, structured and know how to prioritize -- you consider yourself as someone who delivers solutions and not bottlenecks to be solved.
You are willing to do anything necessary for the project to succeed, including working on the warehouse floor when you are short staffed to making a customer delivery, or to take customer calls.
No job is too insignificant, no detail is too small for you.
You are able to interact with senior-level executives and can manage the expectations of multiple stakeholders.
You are someone energized by the unknown and look forward to learning each day on the job.
